content.rendered: "From start to finish, working with Jose Zuniga and his team was a really positive experience. They demonstrated professionalism, expertise, pride in their work and a real commitment to quality. They replaced rotted boards on my deck, replaced the damaged stairs, shored up a corner of the deck that was sinking and repaired a chimney. Their pricing was transparent and fair. Everything was clearly laid out in the estimate, with no surprises. They cleaned up at the end of the day and kept the work site as tidy as possible. Their workmanship was excellent. Everything was done carefully and up to code. When they encountered additional rotted wood beyond what was first visible, they explained my options and offered well-thought-out solutions instead of just patching things together. I highly recommend Jose Zuniga and his team to anyone looking for a trustworthy, skilled contractor. I would hire them again in a heartbeat."

"Was in the market for having my pre-existing 21'x21' carport converted into a garage with 3 walls, a 16' garage door, a side door and siding of some sort. A friend of mine highly recommended JBZ to me from previous work he had accomplished for him and seeing the work done myself I gave them a call. A man named Jose answered, was very professional on the phone asked some questions and answered all of mine. Within 25 hours he himself came to my residence to inspect my project, asked some questions on how i wanted things done, took notes while we were talking and was very easy to talk to. After the inspection was done he sent me a quote that was reasonable that same day and i accepted it. Within 48 hours he and his crew came to my home and were completed on day 2. Even with the problems of working with a pre-existing structure that honestly wasnt built very well he made it way better structurally before even putting up the first wall and built from there. I couldnt be happier with the end result including even matching the garage siding with the siding of my house. Now the garage looks like it was built at the exact same time of my house which was what i was wanting. Cant recommend enough Jose and his crew and will recommend him to anyone needing work done."

"We found Jose through a Yelp search - and we are very satisfied customers! I am preparing my house for sale after 20 years in it, and I had quite a long list of "fix-it" projects. I had gotten halfway through one of the biggest projects (replacing most of a large deck out my back door) and it was taking me way too long. There were many other things I needed fixed ranging from the installation of a ceiling fan, replacement of grout in a shower, installing brand new railings for my front stairs, repairing a fence where trees had smashed it, even replacing a rotting transom in the garage. Jose walked through my house with me and took notes and pictures while I shared my list with him. He got back to me quickly with a very reasonable estimate (including materials) and could get started within a few week. Once he started, he and his crew (Sean) knocked out my deck in a couple of days and quickly and efficiently checked off the things on the list. There was a wide range of different projects they did and they finished it all quickly and did an excellent job regardless the task! It was so nice to see all these projects knocked off the list in speedy fashion. Once they started - my house was the only place they worked and I never had to "track them down" between tasks. Sean and Jose worked well together and also did things concertently - each taking care of different tasks on the list. If I ever need work done in the future - JBZ Home Restoration and Renovations will be my first call for help!"

"Excellent work and professional service! Highly recommend this company! They show up on time and provide useful feedback throughout the process! The worksite is clean afterwards and the price quoted is the price paid."
